hero-creek.alt: Gloved hands press soil around a young oak sapling at a misty creek restoration site, with volunteers out of focus in an oak valley behind.

hero-creek-portrait.alt: Gloved hands plant a young oak sapling beside a misty creek in morning light, with distant volunteers in the valley.

before-clipboard.alt: A paper sign-in sheet of handwritten names on a worn clipboard with a pen and a coffee cup, resting on a wooden crate outdoors.

cover-planting.alt: Newly planted native saplings tied to wooden stakes in watered soil and straw mulch along a creek bank.

cover-food.alt: Volunteers' hands pack apples, carrots, greens and canned goods into cardboard boxes at a food distribution table.

cover-cleanup.alt: Two litter grabbers lean against a metal bucket of collected trash on a San Francisco Bay shoreline at sunset.

cover-tutoring.alt: A tutor's hand points a pencil at a math worksheet on a library table with open notebooks.

cover-shelter.alt: Folded blankets and bagged hygiene kits lined up on a table in a community center.

audience-coordinator.alt: Over-the-shoulder view of a coordinator holding a phone at an outdoor sign-in table with a laptop and a QR code sign, volunteers working in a park beyond.

audience-volunteer.alt: A volunteer's hand holds up a phone to scan a QR code sign on an outdoor sign-in table.

audience-school.alt: A counseling office desk with an open green folder of forms, a closed laptop and a succulent in soft window light.

sapling.alt: Ink and watercolor drawing of a young sycamore sapling with its roots shown in a cross-section of soil.

ledger.alt: Ink and watercolor drawing of an open field notebook with a pressed sycamore leaf and a pencil.

envelope.alt: Ink and watercolor drawing of a sealed envelope closed with a green wax seal stamped with a leaf sprig.

compass.alt: Ink and watercolor drawing of a brass compass resting on a folded topographic trail map.

seed-pod.alt: Ink and watercolor drawing of three round sycamore seed balls hanging from a twig beside a leaf.

leaf-badge.alt: Ink and watercolor drawing of a single sycamore leaf inside a thin green circular border.
